_about: Merge into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (user) for Claude Code users. Claude Code applies its own allow/ask/deny rules, and connectors imported from claude.ai have been reported to ignore their per-tool approval toggles there. These ask rules make Claude Code prompt before CRM writes. Run /mcp to see the exact tool names in your session and add any that differ. Deny always wins over allow.
